headline: Federal Police Report Clears Justice Mendonça In Banco Master Case
seoTitle: Federal Police Report on André Mendonça and Banco Master
metaDescription: A Federal Police report submitted to the Supreme Court confirms Justice André Mendonça had no direct contact with banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding the case.
aiSummaryBullets: A Federal Police report submitted to the Supreme Court found no record of communication between Justice André Mendonça and banker Daniel Vorcaro.
The findings indicate that the justice was mentioned by third parties in 11 separate dialogues recovered from the phone of the former banker.
Supreme Court President Edson Fachin lifted the confidentiality of the report following a formal request from Justice Mendonça to make it public.
aiContextParagraph: The Supreme Court of Brazil has received Federal Police reports concerning references to various justices, including André Mendonça, found on the mobile phone of banker Daniel Vorcaro in relation to the Banco Master investigation. While earlier reporting noted apprehension within the judiciary regarding the contents of these documents, the police concluded that there was no evidence of direct interaction between Justice Mendonça and Vorcaro. Following the submission of the documents, Supreme Court President Edson Fachin announced that the materials would be forwarded to the Prosecutor General's Office for further evaluation. Justice Mendonça subsequently requested that the confidentiality of the specific report detailing his involvement be waived, allowing for full public access to the findings. The Prosecutor General is now establishing a specialized unit to review these reports, a process expected to extend beyond the initial fifteen-day assessment period.
whyItIsViral: The development is widely covered across multiple reports by a national news outlet, reflecting significant ongoing interest in the intersection of federal investigations and the Supreme Court.
